method: Production GCP endpoint; generated 24 kHz mono PCM16, six repeated sentences. Deliberately ignored one storage acknowledgment, replayed its chunk, and disconnected for six seconds while capture time continued.
limitations: Phone disconnected before new microphone/playback engine could be exercised on device.
Live GPT-Live audio forwarding has no provider per-chunk acknowledgments. Durable full-utterance file transcription is authoritative for Codex.
Transcription remains probabilistic; byte-exact ingestion does not guarantee every recognized word.
Five-minute local pending-audio limit stops recording visibly instead of evicting old chunks.
Long uninterrupted speech is transcribed in 30-second fragments; Codex waits for a pause or end of call.
Pending external action with unknown completion is not automatically re-executed.
